title: 第7章 糟老头子坏得很第8章 逛地摊
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
李婉深吸一口气，眼神无比坚定，对着花管事深深躬身：“我自然是进不去的，但花管事您身为宗门管事，定然有出入天机阁的资格。
求您帮我一次，将那手札取来给我一看。只要您肯帮忙，我愿意将今年一半的贡献点全部奉上！”
李婉虽只是刚毕业的学生，却深谙人情世故，知道求人办事空口白牙毫无诚意，索性直接拿出了自己最大的筹码。
她如今每日有十个贡献点，一年便是三千六百点，一半就是一千八百点。
对于一无所有的她来说，这个决定几乎掏空了她所有的积蓄与未来一年的盼头。
但为了灵根，为了修行，她也没有半分犹豫。
花管事指尖轻轻敲击着酒壶，眼中闪过一丝沉吟。
他在流林宗混迹多年，深知百年前那位奇人的旧事。
当年此人以凡人之躯凿出灵根，引得整个修真界疯狂追捧，无数宗门世家趋之若鹜，只求生灵根之法。
那位奇人并未藏私，将自己的修行历程写成手札公之于众，可所有看过手札的人，都心灰意冷。
只因那凝练灵根之法，苛刻到逆天，需要承受非人的痛苦，且成功率微乎其微，百万人中未必能有一人成功。
也正因如此，这手札虽名声在外，却被宗门随意放在了天机阁一层，与寻常功法无异。
用一次免费刻录功法的机会，换一个杂役数年的贡献点，这笔买卖，稳赚不赔。
只是，这点筹码，还远远不够。
花管事抬眼，语气平淡却带着不容置疑的强势：“一年一半？太少。三年，你三年内七成的贡献点归我，我便帮你去天机阁刻录那份手札。”
三年七成！
李婉心中瞬间爆粗口，暗骂这花管事：你这个糟老头子，坏得很！
她每日仅赚得十贡献点，七成便是七点，剩下三点仅够勉强糊口，这是要把她当成免费苦力压榨三年啊！
心中再不满，李婉脸上也不敢显露半分，立刻换上一副可怜巴巴的神情，苦苦哀求：“花管事，您高抬贵手啊！
我家中上有老父老母，下有年幼弟妹，全靠我这点贡献点维系生计。

三年七成，我连饭都吃不上，若是饿坏了身子，没法干活，最后吃亏的还是您啊！”
她一边说，一边偷偷观察花管事的脸色，见其眉头微蹙，面露不耐。
当即心一横，用力挤了两滴眼泪在眼眶里，继续装可怜：“要不……一年半五成？我保证，这一年半里绝对听话懂事，兢兢业业干活，绝不敢有半分二心！”
花管事冷哼一声，衣袖一甩，显然对这个还价极为不满：“一年半五成便想换天机阁的秘典？你简直是痴人说梦！”
他顿了顿，语气愈发冰冷，带着最后的通牒：“最少两年六成，再敢多言半句，休怪我翻脸无情，此事就此作罢！”
两年六成！
李婉心中飞速盘算，这个价格依旧高得离谱，但相比于三年七成，已经好了太多。
content_en:
Li Wan took a deep breath, her eyes were extremely firm, and she bowed deeply to Guanshi Hua: "Of course I can't get in, but Guanshi Hua, as the sect steward, you must have the qualifications to enter and leave Tianji Pavilion.
Please help me once and bring me the manuscript. As long as you are willing to help, I am willing to donate half of this year's contribution points! "
Although Li Wan was only a recent graduate, she was well versed in the ways of the world. She knew that asking for help from others was insincere, so she simply used her biggest bargaining chip.
She now has ten contribution points every day, which is 3,600 points a year, and half of it is 1,800 points.
For her who had nothing, this decision almost wiped out all her savings and expectations for the next year.
But for the sake of spiritual roots and cultivation, she didn't hesitate at all.
Manager Hua tapped the wine bottle lightly with her fingertips, a trace of thought flashed in her eyes.
He has been around Liulin Sect for many years and knows the past events of that strange man a hundred years ago.
Back then, this man used his mortal body to carve out spiritual roots, which attracted the entire world of cultivation to pursue him crazily. Countless sects and families flocked to him, seeking only the method to create spiritual roots.
The strange man did not hide his secrets and wrote down his spiritual practice in a handbook and made it public. However, everyone who read the handbook was disheartened.
Just because the method of condensing spiritual roots is so harsh that it requires enduring inhuman pain, and the success rate is very slim. Not one person in a million may succeed.
Because of this, although this handbook is famous, it was placed on the first floor of Tianji Pavilion by the sect at will, no different from ordinary skills.
Use an opportunity to record exercises for free in exchange for several years of contribution points from a handyman. This deal is a sure profit.
However, this little bargaining chip is not enough.
Manager Hua raised his eyes, and his tone was calm but undeniably strong: "Half a year? Too little. Three years, 70% of your contribution points in three years will belong to me, and I will help you go to Tianji Pavilion to burn the note."
Seventy percent in three years!
Li Wan suddenly cursed in her heart and secretly cursed the flower steward: You are such a bad old man, you are so bad!
She only earns 10 contribution points every day, 70% is 7 points, and the remaining 3 points are just enough to make ends meet. This means that she will be exploited as a free coolie for three years!
No matter how dissatisfied she was, Li Wan didn't dare to show any signs of it on her face. She immediately put on a pitiful expression and begged: "Manager Hua, you are so generous!
I have an old father and mother in my family, as well as younger brothers and sisters. They all rely on my contribution to make ends meet.
Three years and 70%, I can't even eat. If I am starved and unable to work, you will be the one who suffers in the end! "
As she spoke, she secretly observed Manager Hua's face and saw that his brows were slightly furrowed, showing impatience.
Immediately, my heart skipped a beat, and I squeezed two tears from my eyes, and continued to pretend to be pitiful: "How about...50% in one and a half years? I promise, I will be absolutely obedient and sensible in this year and a half, and work conscientiously, and I will never dare to be half-hearted!"
Manager Hua snorted coldly and flicked his sleeves, obviously very dissatisfied with this counter-offer: "You want to change the secret book of Tianji Pavilion in one and a half years? You are simply dreaming!"
He paused, and his tone became colder, with an ultimatum: "At least two years and 60%, if you dare to say more, don't blame me for being ruthless, let this matter be over!"
Sixty percent in two years!
Li Wan quickly calculated in her mind that the price was still ridiculously high, but compared to 70% in three years, it was much better.
